iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran atomic file remains imminent: Reuters reports Tehran still holds a large 60 percent stockpile as bargaining leverage, while IAEA safeguards material says Iran has not provided required access or accounting for sites affected by prior attacks. No verified higher-level enrichment jump or device event surfaced in this scan.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR
iran_conventional.notes: Iran conventional risk edges up: Al Jazeera reports another US strike near Bandar Abbas, Crisis Group/JMIC context shows enhanced Hormuz security controls, and NYT reporting cited Iranian speedboat preparations around the strait. Reuters-linked reporting says Tehran halted indirect US message exchanges and raised Hormuz pressure while Lebanon-linked fighting continues.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon remains near-max: Reuters reports Hezbollah rejected the Washington-declared framework, Israel says it will keep striking Lebanon and not withdraw from southern positions, and Al Jazeera live coverage shows continuing attacks around southern Lebanon despite the announced framework.

turkey.name: TURKEY
turkey.notes: Turkey remains deterrent: the scan returned analysis and social/video fragments about Ankara balancing the Iran war and possible Syrian-position reinforcement, but no credible fresh Turkey-centered NATO kinetic trigger or official atomic rhetoric signal.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan stays low elevated: BBC says the ceasefire still holds one year after the prior clash even though ties remain frozen; Foreign Affairs and CFR context underline structural escalation risk, but this scan found no fresh border exchange or bilateral force surge.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO remains imminent by spillover: PBS and Al Jazeera report growing Baltic drone-risk and need for de-escalation channels, while Russian atomic-threat rhetoric remains an active backdrop. No confirmed direct NATO-Russia kinetic contact surfaced.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan remains critical but not accelerating: search results were dominated by prior Reuters blockade-simulation and live-fire-drill evidence rather than a fresh June trigger. No new blockade, landing, or direct clash was verified.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: DPRK rises within elevated: NPR/AP-style coverage reports Kim unveiled a new facility for strategic-weapons fuel and called for rapid arsenal growth. The scan did not surface a fresh projectile launch or atomic detonation confirmation.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine remains near-max: Reuters reports one of the largest Russian drone and projectile barrages against Kyiv and other cities, with at least 11 killed and more than 100 wounded after Kremlin warnings of systematic strikes. Long-range strike cycles and nuclear rhetoric keep escalation pressure high.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan remains critical: AMU reports Taliban forces claimed destruction of a Pakistani border outpost as clashes entered a 12th day; Reuters February evidence of retaliatory border attacks remains the baseline escalation pattern.

sudan.name: SUDAN
sudan.notes: Sudan remains critical: BBC reports dozens killed in an El-Fasher drone strike on a displacement shelter and fresh ICC/war-crimes concern; no separate regional intervention trigger exceeded the existing baseline.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza/Israel-Palestine rises: Reuters and BBC report 10-11 killed in Gaza strikes on June 4 as stand-down efforts falter; humanitarian and political pressure remains high.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN-ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan-Abyei falls to low elevated: no fresh 24h Abyei clash, peacekeeper casualty, or new border-force surge surfaced; returned items were stale background on the disputed region.
